rule: Each level shows at most the threshold number of activities; move the rest into a child level
Every activity has at least one line in or out
When an activity has more than one outgoing line every one of them is labelled with its condition
Every level shows what starts it with a line from START
The capability tree is at most the threshold number of levels deep: two levels of headings over cards and a fourth level drawn as list lines on its parent card; deeper levels are not drawn
When there is more than one entity every entity has at least one relationship
Every role performs at least one activity
Names of activities roles and capabilities are business language rather than API names
Everything the model expects on this diagram is drawn and nothing is drawn that the model does not have
A child level's lines in and out match the lines into and out of the box it drills down from
No two boxes overlap
Inferred items are flagged: an inferred box has a note attachment titled Inferred and an inferred line's label ends with (inferred)
Every line leaves and enters a box at the middle of the side data/line-sides.csv gives it
Boxes in a row share their middle and boxes in a column share their left edge to within the threshold in pixels
No box sits in the space the style file (data/style-process.csv or data/style-interaction.csv) keeps clear for a start or end line
No line is likely to run through a box it does not join
A decision box has at most the threshold number of different outcomes
Each logic level shows at most the threshold number of steps; move loop bodies and long branches into drill-downs
Every step has at least one line in or out
When a step has more than one outgoing line every one of them is labelled with its condition
An automation's own logic level has exactly one Start step
Names of automations and steps are labels people read rather than API names
A card lists at most the threshold number of attributes
A footer summary is at most the threshold number of characters
When the model has more than one automation every automation is joined to the chain by an interaction
Every card and sub-heading sits below the heading of the capability it belongs to and in that heading's column
No two cards or labels overlap and cards stacked in a column keep at least the sibling gap
Column headers in one row share their top and every card sits where the layout puts it from the sizes Elements reports to within the threshold in pixels
A data model shows at most the threshold number of entities; split a larger one into several maps by area
A relationship's fromEnd and toEnd agree with its cardinality: a many end only where the cardinality says many
Every card is where the plan put it to within the threshold in pixels and no two cards overlap or touch
Every relationship is drawn once between the right two cards with the planned line ends and every card shows its planned fields with their descriptions and its planned API name and colour
No line is likely to run through a card it does not join
Each level (the top and each group's drill-down) shows at most the threshold number of systems; put related systems in a group
When a level has more than one system every system has at least one integration
Every integration has a label, technology or pattern so its line says how the data moves
An integration that names a pattern has Salesforce at the end the pattern needs: the caller for request and reply and fire and forget, the receiver for remote call-in and data virtualization
An integration's technology is not a mechanism Well-Architected rates suboptimal for its pattern (data/integration-mechanisms.csv)
An integration's timing is one its pattern allows (data/integration-patterns.csv)
A card shows at most the threshold number of footer icons; more make it wider than the others
A card lists at most the threshold number of attributes
Every card is where the plan put it to within the threshold in pixels and no two cards overlap
Every integration is drawn once between the right two cards with the planned arrows and label; every card shows its planned icon attributes and footer; every group card has its drill-down
No line is likely to run through a card it does not join
A system's drill-down (its middleware, automations and objects, drawn when its integrations list them) shows at most the threshold number of cards
